attack.note: The guide calls his basic attack very strong, and it is melee until Fetid Touch makes it ranged and slowing at 35 percent less damage.

poke.note: Lurking Arm deals 136 per second and silences everything in an area, and can be channeled indefinitely. Weighted Pustule is a slow and a delayed burst. Measured hero damage 1120 per minute.

damage.note: Silence zone denies abilities more than it deals damage. Damage from Lurking Arm is small per tick.

healing.note: Healing Pathogen is 222 over 4.5 seconds and spreads to nearby allies, and Bio-Kill Switch detonates each one for 435 instantly (30 percent more with Vigorous Reuptake at 3 or more). That gives both sustain between detonations and a very large AoE burst every 16 seconds. Pox Populi and Top Off push sustain. It needs allies grouped within spread range.

good_into.why: Healing Pathogen spreads a heal over time to the whole team and Bio-Kill Switch detonates all of it at once, covering spread chip damage and burst, and Lurking Arm zones the poke Heroes out of position.
Lurking Arm silence zone at a choke, Weighted Pustule slow, Flailing Swipe and Massive Shove remove melee Heroes from the fight, and Virulent Reaction roots them inside the zone.
Lurking Arm can be dropped on a Hero channeling a heroic to cancel it, with a low cooldown.
A channeled silence zone on a choke or objective forces the enemy to concede or push through, and Massive Shove can stun a Hero into a wall.

bad_into.why: High mobility Heroes jump over the zone and he has no mobility and no escape of his own. Massive Shove is a skillshot that mobile Heroes dodge.
He has no cleanse or Unstoppable, and a channeled Lurking Arm leaves him standing still. Superstrain only heals after the stun.
Divers skip the zone and kill a healer who has to stand with allies to spread Pathogen, though Reactive Ballistospores and Massive Shove armor give some answer.
Melee body with low health and no mobility. Reactive Ballistospores resets Bio-Kill Switch below 50 percent health but that is the only protection.

wants_from_team: Allies who fight grouped within Healing Pathogen range
Reliable crowd control to land Virulent Reaction and Growing Infestation
Heroes who like slowed targets (Executioner style)
A frontline that holds the choke while he channels
gives_team: Big AoE burst heal on a 16 second detonation
Disengage or pick with Flailing Swipe and Massive Shove
weaknesses: Bio-Kill Switch is a long cooldown tool

Measured block: 56.4 seconds of enemy stun root or silence per game, 1120 hero damage per minute
owner_notes: A healer who mixes sustain and burst healing but excels at neither. His strength is the AoE channelled silence. No solid escape beyond Swipes to push people back, and dive can focus him when the team has no front line. Drafted with taunt Varian or another easy to hit CC tank, he silences under the target and the team bursts the taunted target with a ranged assassin like Jaina, whose damage is quick and not blocked by minions or heroes (Greymane, Li-Ming, Kel'Thuzad, Kael'thas also work). It fails when the other team can save the target: Anduin's pull counters it, and so do Medivh or Uther Divine Shield or Tyrael's invulnerability. Cleanses help, but the silence can still get kills when the target is cleansed.

lens_notes.healer_class: Healing Pathogen spreads and Bio-Kill Switch detonates for burst. Owner says he mixes sustain and burst and excels at neither, the silence is his strength.
lens_notes.healer_safety: Melee range basic attack and the Lurking Arm channel leave him exposed, and dive can focus him when the team has no front line (owner).
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Silence under a taunted or CC held target and a ranged burst hero finishes (Jaina, Greymane, Li-Ming, Kel'Thuzad, Kael'thas). It fails when the target is saved: Anduin pull, Medivh, Uther Divine Shield, Tyrael.
lens_notes.escape: Owner: no solid escape. Flailing Swipe pushes enemies away and Massive Shove gives 50 Armor, but that is peel, not an exit.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Lurking Arm silence channel plus Massive Shove stun and Weighted Pustule slow. Reliability depends on the target not being saved.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Massive Shove (heroic, 20 second cooldown) takes one hero out of a fight. Flailing Swipe is the team disengage option.
lens_notes.wave_clear_style: Lurking Arm removes a wave quickly but he is vulnerable while channelling.

lens_gaps: no value in vulnerable_to for enemy save tools (invulnerability, pulls, Divine Shield) that cancel a lockdown comp
no lens for a hero that wants a specific partner kind (a taunt or easy to hit CC tank plus a ranged burst assassin)
no healer_class value for healing that is mainly an instant AoE burst on a cooldown (Bio-Kill Switch)
